explorer.intro: Pick a command group to see its commands, key options and output. The list is generated from the tool itself.

items.title: Documented exit codes
items.detail: Validation failures, usage errors, missing or unsupported input, failed operations, failed output and cancellation each return their own code, so a pipeline can branch on the result.

items.title: Machine-readable output
items.detail: JSON for reports and inspection, NDJSON for streams of results, SARIF for provenance findings in code scanning.

items.title: Safe by default
items.detail: Conversions refuse to overwrite an existing file unless you pass --force, and input and output sizes are bounded.

items.title: Resumable batches
items.detail: workflow batch records each file's state, so rerunning the same command skips finished work and --retry-failed picks up the rest.

items.title: Pinned versions
items.detail: Install it as a local tool in a manifest and run dotnet officeimo, so every machine and CI job uses the same version.

items.title: The same engines everywhere
items.detail: The CLI runs the OfficeIMO libraries in process. It doesn't call Office or LibreOffice.
